categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai SBT Ultrasonic Technology Co., Ltd. focuses on the research, design, production, and sales of ultrasonic welding, cutting equipment, and accessories. Its products primarily serve the new energy battery, automotive wiring harness, semiconductor, rubber tire, and non-woven fabric industries. The company also provides automation solutions for new energy power battery manufacturing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed a comprehensive ultrasonic technology platform including ultrasonic power supply, piezoelectric transducer simulation design, acoustic tool design, controller development, intelligent online detection, and automation systems. Key innovations include integrated wedge welding technology, ultrasonic metal welding quality monitoring, high-speed rolling welding systems, dual-phase synchronous ultrasonic power technology, ultrasonic dust removal, AI-based bonding quality control, ultrasonic detection algorithms, and high-frequency high-power transducers. Production combines in-house processing, assembly, testing, and outsourcing of non-core processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading enterprises in new energy batteries such as CATL, BYD, EVE Energy, Guoxuan High-Tech, and others; automotive wiring harness and connector companies like LEMO, TE Connectivity, Aptiv, Amphenol, Sumitomo, and domestic firms including BYD and Luxshare Precision. Semiconductor clients include SAIC Infineon, CRRC Times, Zhenhua Technology, and others. The company also serves major tire manufacturers such as Goodyear, Hankook, Zhongce Rubber, and others.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Shanghai and subsidiaries in Wuxi, Hong Kong, Singapore, Germany, and other locations. Its sales and services cover domestic markets extensively and include some overseas markets, with foreign currency transactions mainly in USD, EUR, and SGD.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai SBT Ultrasonic Technology operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, manufacturing ultrasonic welding and cutting equipment and providing automation solutions to downstream manufacturers in new energy batteries, automotive wiring harnesses, semiconductors, and other industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous R&D investment to maintain technological leadership, focusing on ultrasonic welding and cutting technologies, intelligent monitoring systems, and expanding applications into semiconductor advanced packaging, medical, hydrogen energy, and aerospace sectors. It collaborates with top universities and institutes to accelerate innovation and industrialization. The company also emphasizes platform-based development and integration of upstream and downstream processes.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of ultrasonic welding and cutting equipment, related accessories, and automation solutions. The company employs a direct sales model supported by a dedicated marketing and technical service team. It also earns income from after-sales services and customized product development.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with international leaders such as Branson (Emerson), Telsonic, Sonics, Herrmann, Sonoscan, K&S, ASM, and PVA in ultrasonic equipment markets. It has gradually broken foreign monopolies in certain segments like high-power ultrasonic torque welding for connectors and is recognized as a leading domestic player with increasing market share in China’s ultrasonic equipment industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 584.55 million, a year-on-year increase of 11.3%, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 85.87 million, up 29.04%. Total assets were RMB 2.13 billion with a slight decrease from the previous year. R&D investment accounted for 21.65% of revenue. The company has shown steady growth with expanding sales in wiring harness and semiconductor equipment despite challenges in the new energy battery sector.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes advanced ultrasonic technology with superior welding quality, stability, and efficiency compared to traditional methods. Its integrated ultrasonic welding quality monitoring system and high-speed rolling welding technology provide real-time quality assurance. The company offers customized solutions with strong R&D capabilities, rapid response, and localized service, differentiating itself from foreign competitors by combining innovation with cost-effectiveness and customer intimacy.
